payload.goal: Review the bug fix and all four SignalShape contract files, then commit the changes and merge to main.

state.root_cause: math.js line 4 used the subtraction operator (`a - b`) instead of addition (`a + b`), causing correct output only for the degenerate case where both operands are zero.
state.fix_applied: Changed `return a - b` to `return a + b` in examples/workflows/debug-failing-tests/app/math.js

decisions.what: Write the test suite before touching the implementation
decisions.why: TDD surfaces the exact assertion failures that pinpoint the wrong operator; without tests the bug could remain hidden indefinitely

decisions.what: Fix the operator in math.js rather than patching individual test cases
decisions.why: The tests described correct behaviour; the implementation was wrong — adjusting tests would invert the semantics of the module

decisions.what: Keep the zero-case test (add(0, 0) === 0) even though it passes with either operator
decisions.why: It documents a boundary value and would catch a future regression to a multiply or other operator; removing it reduces coverage without benefit

decisions.what: Emit a SignalShape contract at every agent boundary (planner, builder, debug-agent, fixer, verifier)
decisions.why: Structured envelopes make the reasoning of each agent machine-readable and auditable, demonstrating the core SignalShape value proposition

next.action: Review math.js and math.test.js to confirm the fix and test coverage are acceptable
Read the four SignalShape contract files (01 through 04) as a complete narrative of the agent workflow
Stage and commit all changes under `examples/workflows/debug-failing-tests/` with a descriptive message referencing the bug fix and the SignalShape demo
Merge the branch to main (or open a pull request) so the workflow example is available to other contributors
Consider extending the workflow with additional edge-case tests (non-integer inputs, very large numbers, NaN) to raise coverage above 90%

risks.risk: a forced termination can prevent run-demo.sh from deleting its temporary app copy
risks.mitigation: all replay mutations occur under mktemp outside the repository; a forced termination may leave disposable temp files but cannot change tracked math.js

risks.risk: The test suite covers only integer inputs; floating-point or non-numeric arguments are untested
risks.mitigation: Add tests for add(1.5, 2.5), add(NaN, 1), and add('a', 'b') to harden the contract before shipping

risks.risk: This workflow is a demo with a deliberately simple bug; real workflows may have multi-file root causes that a single debug-agent pass cannot fully diagnose
risks.mitigation: SignalShape supports chaining multiple debug contracts; document this pattern in the workflow README for teams adopting it on production codebases
